Workflow report templates copied from gcfntnu/gcf-workflows revision 26fafe406d856b49beead1ecce251cc943e56e63, misc/multiqc, unchanged except as noted below. These are public software configuration, without project data. The GCF logo is copied from gcfntnu/gcf-docker multiqc/files. Tests override only the logo location and add synthetic metadata. No operational configuration or customer data is included.

The smallrna template adds the `cutadapt` section order of gcf-workflows PR 351 (cutadapt filter route); the smallrna profile test selects that PR's module list with `gcf_smallrna_cutadapt` in place of `cutadapt`. The cutadapt fixtures (`tests/fixtures/cutadapt/`) are cutadapt 5.2 reports of synthetic reads, with file paths replaced by synthetic names.
